short.text: Brent Grimes was a strong starting cornerback for Jacksonville in 2013, dressing for all {{2013.regular.games}} regular-season games and both playoff games. He was a technically sharp coverage corner with excellent short-area reactions, eyes and ball play, strongest in off coverage and pattern recognition. Size, power and getting off blocks were less favorable, and his tackling and penalty discipline trailed his coverage.

transactions.text: Signed a one-year, fully guaranteed contract with Jacksonville as a free agent
Contract with Jacksonville expired; became an unrestricted free agent
No June 1 tender from Jacksonville; Jacksonville retained no rights
